title: MCP Tool Boundary Hardening

operatorSteps.title: Review MCP tool risk records
operatorSteps.instruction: Review the assessment and mcp-tool-risk records to identify tools with command, filesystem, network, or hidden-instruction exposure.

operatorSteps.title: Plan tool segmentation
operatorSteps.instruction: Draft a non-executing segmentation plan that separates network, memory, filesystem, and command-capable tools behind independent policy gates.

operatorSteps.title: Record reassessment command
operatorSteps.instruction: Record the command that should be run after controls are applied by an approved operator.

recommendedControls: Require authentication for MCP server access.
Set additionalProperties=false for tool argument schemas.
Separate high-risk tool permissions into independently gated tools.
Remove policy-confusing instructions from tool descriptions.
Require explicit approval before enabling command-capable tools.
nonClaims: This playbook does not invoke MCP tools.
This playbook does not modify MCP servers.
This playbook does not authorize live remediation.
